combo_label: The Office × The Olympics × Paddington Bear

entries.clue: Three-step platform where first, second and third stand to be honoured
Sprung jaw that punches a wire fastener through a wad of sheets and bends it flat
Short internal bulletin sent round to all staff, ancestor of the group email
Bear's foot, offered for shaking when a courteous introduction is due
Long unblinking look, the hard sort Aunt Lucy taught for use on rude adults
Saying please and thank you without fail, the bear's chief virtue
Neck cord carrying the security pass that gets you through the door
South American republic whose deepest, darkest corner reared a certain bear
Race with no stroke prescribed, in which everyone picks the crawl
Fencing blade whose hits count on the trunk, never on arms or legs
Round a young traveller's neck it hung, begging that he be looked after
Heavy plate whirled from a caged circle, immortalised by a Greek sculptor
Wall-pinned schedule of turns, showing which unlucky soul is on washing-up
